notes.title: Matchmaking & beta launched!
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for your patience!

This is a big moment for me as I've been cooking this update for quite a while, and I've learned a whole lot making this into a game more people can actually play. I am excited to announce that [b]Steam playtesting[/b] should be ready either [b]before the end of the year, or very early into 2024![/b]

I will be running a playtest through Discord very soon.

[h1]Major changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Implemented quick-play matchmaking system. This will currently pair 6 players together of completely random skill levels in the same region (matchmaking algorithm subject to change, but I will be as transparent as possible with future matchmaking algorithms).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43044258/a5a261124ebc08272ce171b68f9a20a56a3ae0e7.png[/img]
[*]  Inventory has moved from PlayFab over to Steam. Due to the way that Steam handles inventories, unique items are no longer available (e.g. items for just one SteamID). However, playtesters will now automatically be granted the Playtester's Hat and other items if you login to the game with a playtest key.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43044258/256823950ba082155d6c308c01f55d5883804405.png[/img]
[*]  Put some Christmas decorations up
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43044258/d487fff3c5e2449e941b12c32b690ef005045b5a.png[/img]
[*]  Added a character preview in the inventory.
[*]  Added crowd with better sound for events
[*]  Added basic controller support in-game.
[*]  Key rebinding menu has been added
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43044258/efd2fe3bc03613c17e5e68c63f37da2d7727b323.png[/img]
[*]  Most UI elements have been redesigned
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43044258/bece21deecab2ad89f63cbbea962be9cc703b53a.png[/img]
[*]  Improved visibility of the ball, it now glows slightly and has a trail
[*]  Improved visibility of nameplates
[*]  Added images for events instead of pure text.
[*]  Added XP popups for shots on goal, saves and goals.
[*]  Added look up and down animations.
[*]  The jump pad SFX now follow the Effects volume.
[*]  The button UI SFX now follows the Effects volume.
[/list]

[h1]Minor fixes/tweaks[/h1]
- Improved crowd SFX, reactions to goals and other events.
- Removed visibility of hat items from first person
- Stadium has been remodelled for a smoother roof and all vertex gaps have been sealed. This looks much better and greatly reduces the chance of the ball going out of bounds. Textures have also been updated.
- Multiple events can now display correctly at once.
- Added some custom debug commands. You can view all players in a match or lobby by typing "playerlist" into the console, then copy their Steam ID by typing "copyid [index]". You can use this to report players through Discord or troubleshoot login issues.
- Removed Volleyball (I am working on a new seasonal gamemode!)
- Removed crates
- Fixed the ball prediction circle not projecting correctly on jump pads. It still doesn't project onto walls due to a limitation related to translucent materials in Unreal Engine, and I am actively looking for a workaround.
- Fixed multiple replication issues with the player state, such as player names and events not resetting properly.
- Fixed some fullscreen UI elements not scaling properly to fit the screen.
- Multiple elements now changed to scale to content properly.
- Fixed an issue where an event could show with no player reference.
- Fixed player nameplates and cosmetics not loading for players who connected after others, until they respawned.
- Fixed the player seeing their own nametag.
- Changed the team color system to allow for possible further customisation and synchronisation between characters.
- Fixed the jarring sensitivity and FOV changes when spawning in, caused by the settings loaded at a delayed rate. Settings now apply as soon as the character is possessed.
- Fixed an issue where if you hosted a private match and opened the menu quickly, it could open 2 menus and lock out input.
- Fixed an issue where a shot on goal would be credited for a shot aimed at the player's own goal.
- Fixed a bug where after an own goal, no goal effects would play for the rest of the match
- Fixed a replication issue where a player could show twice on a scoreboard, or on the wrong team
- Fixed a case where saves would not track properly
- Improved animation code performance
- Fixed an issue where the podium nametags would only show your own name.

[h3]Known issues[/h3]
- Discord Rich Presence has been temporarily disabled.
- Performance in the new Christmas main menu is poor.
- Shadow quality dramatically affects performance more than expected. Lower shadow quality options still have good performance.

notes.title: Playermodel tweaks & fixes
notes.content:
[h1]Alpha v0.17.1[/h1]

[h2]Visual changes:[/h2]
- The playermodel now displays as more abstract colors to help with visibility. I am also working on 3D modelling some custom playermodels as well as crowd animations.
- Reduced the maximum size of the ball outline highlight.

[h2]General fixes:[/h2]
- Scoreboard is now sorted by points
- Podium now shows players on the correct podium step for their team position.
- Fixed the "Reflection captures need to be rebuilt" warning.

- XP is now distributed differently. The XP awarded per match is now given based on the following algorithm:
XP awarded = (600 / position in team) * win multiplier

The "win multiplier" is 1 on a loss, 1.5x on a win.
"Position in team" means the position on the scoreboard.
This should also fix an issue where all players in the match got the same amount of XP as the hosting player.

notes.title: Alpha v0.17 - Movement & QOL changes
notes.content:
[h1]Alpha v0.17[/h1]

[h2]General:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43044258/6a19d9e21f85c2261c62af7206090959c753f76e.png[/img]
- A podium has been added at the end of a match, displaying the winners (this currently doesn't display them in order of score, but it will eventually).
- Music has been added to the main menu
- Changed jump pad sound effect
- Added a chat box. This will eventually be used for quick chats, but right now it is limited to server messages (e.g. player leave/join).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43044258/71bc05c28a85b0e8ca482c096aabd140b3084b0f.png[/img]
- Ping numbers on the scoreboard are now colored to match connection quality.
- More coherent error messages are now displayed if you encounter an error logging in with PlayFab.
- Visual changes to jump pads. They now blink slightly aswell as being color matched to their position on the field.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43044258/74ba0179c1a0b1319878c27e4fa9d6f18afce170.png[/img]
- "Scramble Teams" button in the host menu is now enabled.

[h2]Movement:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43044258/b9781f3022dbe3baf38e7acde61936d6cc76d0d7.png[/img]
- You can no longer walk on top of each player's heads.

Some players found that jump pads would actually disadvantage them at times, giving an unexpected jump boost they weren't expecting and therefore missing the ball. Jump pads should never be a disadvantage, as they cover the defensive parts of the map to allow for blocking of clears or saves. 
The following changes have been made to address this:

- Jump pads now give extra jump hold time instead of base velocity. Now, when starting a jump on a jump pad you can hold space for up to 600ms to go further, allowing for more granular control.

- You can now crouch. New animations have been added to support this.

Bug fixes:
- Goal distance now shows correctly
- Saves should now track correctly and award points.
- Fixed XP not being awarded correctly at the end of a match.
- Many fixes and changes to Discord RPC. It will now show your level correctly, and will refresh when you join a new game, showing the amount of players connected.
- Ping numbers no longer display decimals for the host.
- Restructured a lot of code and folders internally to streamline updates.

notes.title: LUNARBALL Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Alpha v0.16.51[/h1]

[h3]Gameplay/Physics[/h3]
- Changed ball model for a brighter one
- Ball is now slightly smaller to allow for easier 3-point shots. The hitbox is the same size for punches and kicks.
- Added ball indicator
- Added bounce prediction indicator
- Enabled continuous collision detection on the ball to prevent it being pushed out of bounds
- Enabled smooth edge collisions on the ball. This should make it bounce off objects which are composed of multiple meshes more predictably.
- Reduced player physics push force factor by 25%, and increased the repulsion force. This should make the ball more reliably interact with player bodies and reduce random pinches against walls.
- Added a glow and sound while standing on a jump pad
- Fixed the Galaxy goal explosion

[h3]Inventory:[/h3]
- Fixed an issue where you could open multiple crates at a time
- Fixed an exploit related to infinite money (smh)
- Fixed visual indicator for equipped items
- You will no longer see a Legendary tier item inside of a crate unless you land on it.
- Fixed goal explosions not working correctly

[h3]Animation:[/h3]
- Adjusted the running animation to match the direction

[h3]Sound:[/h3]
- Added different crowd noises for different parts of the field
- Added a sound when the ball bounces
- Tweaked reverb in the stadium
